_doc: #1975 the trip roadmap, MOVED from Cloud Me > Pers > Achieves > Geo (its last three blocks; test/data/geo-trip-blocks-1975.json is the frozen copy and test-tasks-trip-parity.sh holds every field against it). Same blocks, same labels, subtitles, icons, accents. Targets: `cloudme:page:<section>/<page>` opens that page of Cloud Me (a deep link: its MainActivity reads the shortcut_action extra), `tasks:<section>/<page>` opens a page of this app (the Calendar is Tasks' own), `extapp:<id>` launches the app of `apps`.

blocks.body: The four checklists below are the parts of a trip that are forgettable and expensive to forget. Each opens the app that holds that piece — Cloud Me tracks the shape of a trip, not its contents.
